# grok-icon-study placeholder

The JavaScript files in this directory are copied from
<https://github.com/blessonism/grok-icon-study> for Seek's non-commercial,
personal learning project.

The upstream repository describes the code as a learning study and states that
the referenced character geometry and assets belong to xAI / their respective
rights holders. The Seek project owner has separately obtained the author's
permission to use this implementation as a placeholder mascot.
